body.condition: Uniformly over \(P\in\mathcal F_s\), for each of the inner transport \(p\) and the outer transport \(T\), the Hessian with respect to the two harmonic lift coordinates of the intrinsic quadratic transport cost, after the scalar pushforward equation has been solved on the selected no-cut branch, is positive definite and has smallest eigenvalue bounded below by a constant independent of \(P\).

novel.justification: novel: uniform nondegeneracy of the reduced harmonic branch cost for both nested torus transports
